changelog:
watchitai v2.2.0 is now integrated as a cross-platform, self-contained remote desktop/screen sharing skill.

- Adds full documentation for cross-platform screen sharing and remote control via WebRTC P2P, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- No longer requires Node.js: uses Go binaries for improved portability and ease of use.
- Details extensive command-line usage, AI agent integration, and security practices.
- Provides comprehensive setup and installation instructions for multiple AI platforms (OpenClaw, Trae, Claude Code, etc.).
- Explains permissions, configuration, and account authorization steps for seamless experience.
- Summarizes all available commands, supported features, and technical details of the bridge API.
summary: Cross-platform screen sharing, remote desktop control, and real-time monitoring for AI agents. View and control your computer screen from any phone or browser via WebRTC P2P. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. No Node.js required — self-contained Go binaries.
